boundaries: A matrix proposal is not an active rule until its owner issues the policy and the participant sees the exact version.
A browser event or transcript style does not prove a prohibited resource was used; accessibility aids and approved research-arm allowances must remain distinct.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One challenge administration policy version and declared participant or controlled research arm.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Assistance Permission Matrix meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: The clear table telling a developer what help is allowed in each session and when, without pretending browser signals can prove cheating.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: An Assistance Permission Matrix is a versioned, participant-visible mapping from session, phase, tool or help category and research arm to a proposed or authorized allowance, required disclosure, accessibility exception and handling route, pinned to an Administration Policy before case exposure.
